title: lesson_progress
description: One row per (user, lesson) — 322 lessons. Records what the learner DID (`status`, the counts, the score) separately from what the data SAYS (`mastery`), because collapsing the two makes "completed" unfalsifiable. RUNTIME class: minted per learner, never committed to this repo. The mastery THRESHOLD is a named parameter block, not a constant, and it is PENDING owner decision D2 — see design/user_state.md §6.1.

x-yomineko.note: Composite key. There is no synthesized id: (user_id, lesson) is already unique and minting a surrogate would create a second address for one fact.

lesson.description: The lesson leaf, by stable id.

status.description: What the learner did. The timestamps below carry the when; this is what a query filters on. Deliberately independent of `mastery`: a learner can finish a lesson without meeting the mastery criterion, and pretending otherwise hides the case the criterion exists to find. Vocabulary owner: design — design/user_state.md#6-lesson_progress. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

attempts.description: How many times the lesson was sat. A lesson may be re-sat.

score.description: exercises_correct / exercises_attempted, frozen at completion. Null until then — a running score reported as a result is a lie about what was measured.

cards_seeded.description: Whether completing this lesson minted its cards. FALSE after a successful test-out: passing marks the stage's words known WITHOUT seeding them as new FSRS cards (design/learning_science.md §4.5). Without this flag, "completed" and "carded" are indistinguishable and the daily new-card cap gets spent on material the learner demonstrably already knew.

mastery.description: One evaluated verdict plus the parameters that produced it. `criterion` is stored on the row rather than assumed by the reader precisely so that D2 can change the threshold without invalidating rows already evaluated under the old one.

state.description: `unknown` is the honest default: no evaluation has run. It is NOT the same as not_met. Vocabulary owner: design — design/user_state.md#6-lesson_progress. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

criterion.description: Which parameter block produced the verdict. MASTERY_V1 = retrieval_threshold 0.90, min_interval_days 1, scope prior_stage_items, counts_kinds [recognition] — from design/learning_science.md §4.5 (">=90% of the prior stage's words reaching a first successful review at interval >=1 day"). PENDING owner decision D2: what "lesson complete" means and whether placement seeds cards. A changed threshold is a NEW value here (MASTERY_V2), never a redefinition of this one. Vocabulary owner: design — design/user_state.md#61-mastery-one-evaluated-verdict-plus-the-parameters-that-produced-it. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

observed.description: The measured fraction the verdict was read off, so `met` can be audited instead of trusted.
